name: Shoebutton ardisia
desc: Shoebutton ardisia (Ardisia elliptica): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 29 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ardisia elliptica is an evergreen tree, also known as the shoebutton ardisia, duck's eye and coralberry, native to the west coast of India, Sri Lanka, Indochina, Malaysia, Indonesia and New Guinea.
